title: Verth
lines: Every day, someone in India loses money to a message that looked real.
A bank asking you to update your KYC. A son asking for money from a new number. A job that wants a small fee first.
Verth helps you check, before you pay.
Paste any message, link, phone number or screenshot, and Verth shows you the warning signs in seconds.
If someone asks for money in the name of your family, or your boss, Verth asks the real person, on their own phone.
Your dashboard shows your checks, and your family's safety, at a glance.
And a one-minute daily check-up keeps your phone safe from common tricks.
Your messages are checked on your own device. Nothing is uploaded.
Verth. Check before you pay. Try it free at verth dot in.
